context: Migrate test imports first, delete the shim and alias, and prove no importer remains anywhere in the repository.
description: From the 2026-08-09 adversarial review of PR #1644, deferred at merge without a tracker record. benchbox/core/analysis/comparison.py keeps _normalize_execution_time_ms (line 961) and a _DURATION_CONSISTENCY_TOLERANCE_MS alias solely so tests can import private shims; no production code calls either. The module docstring says the batch exists to eliminate parallel duration-normalization surfaces, and this shim is a third one. Migrate the tests to import query_execution_from_legacy_dict and DURATION_CONSISTENCY_TOLERANCE_MS from benchbox.core.results.query_execution, then delete the shim and alias.

anti_patterns.dont: Keep private cross-module shims alive for test convenience.
anti_patterns.instead: Import the canonical public helpers directly in tests.
anti_patterns.why: They accumulate as parallel normalization surfaces the batch set out to eliminate.

anti_patterns.dont: Move the tolerance constant into comparison to preserve the import path.
anti_patterns.instead: Delete the alias and import from the canonical module.
anti_patterns.why: That would recreate a second authority for the same value.

preserves.behavior: Comparison production behavior is byte-for-byte unchanged for all inputs.
Test coverage of duration normalization semantics is retained against the canonical module.
The canonical tolerance constant remains defined only in benchbox.core.results.query_execution.

prior_art.concept: Canonical duration normalization and tolerance constant.

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c "import benchbox.core.analysis.comparison as c; assert not hasattr(c, '_normalize_execution_time_ms')"
verifications.expected: Exits nonzero on the unfixed tree while the shim exists; exits 0 after removal.

verifications.description: Comparison tests pass against canonical imports
verifications.expected: All comparison tests pass importing from the canonical module.

verifications.command: uv run -- ruff check benchbox/core/analysis/comparison.py tests/unit/core/analysis

work_units.summary: Migrate test imports to the canonical query_execution module
Delete the shim and tolerance alias and prove no importer remains
